name: filter_repo_layer

test_list.description: nebius.base_url from a repo layer is UntrustedRepoKey.
sandbox.tier from a repo layer is UntrustedRepoKey.
ui.*, log.level, concurrency.* and ratelimit.* pass through.
A trust grant for sandbox.tier lets exactly that key through.
A literal credential in a repo layer is SecretLiteral (distinct from UntrustedRepoKey).

inputs.name: grant
inputs.description: Keys the user trusted for this repo.

output_description: Repo config is attacker-controlled input; only allow-listed keys are accepted.
